text:
maya: Heads-up 1: iterating on Alerting > Threshold row + notification preview. Goal: clearer simulation copy, keyboard order, and compact inline failures. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/alerts (frame: simulate). Quick reactions?

oliver: Prefer 'Simulate notification' for CTA. Makes non-persistence explicit. Also show a tiny payload summary collapsed by default.

sam: Copy tweak for threshold line: 'Trigger when request error rate > 5% over a 5-minute rolling window' 1. Removes ambiguity about window.

a11y-bot: Use aria-live="polite" with template string: "Simulation complete: {successCount} channels, {failCount} failed (simulated)". Ensure channel pills have aria-pressed and keyboard operability.

design-bot: Flow: focus moves to primary CTA when modal opens, tab through summary -> channel pills -> close. Esc returns focus to threshold toggle.

oliver: If a channel fails (500/429), surface inline small toast next to that pill with retry. No global banner.

maya: I'll update fig: header 'Preview (simulated 1 won't change routes)', CTA 'Simulate notification', helper 'Last simulated: 1'. Will push patch PR for aria-live string and tab order later today.

a11y-bot: After PR ping me; I'll run quick VoiceOver/NVDA smoke tests and report focus/announcement issues.
